claim.note: Heading at the wrong level: 4.4 is a sibling of '### 4.2 CONFIGURATION SECTION' (page 241) and a child of '## 4.'; it should be ### with 4.4.1-4.4.4 at ####.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page VI-11 shows '4.4 THE OBJECT-COMPUTER PARAGRAPH' with subclauses 4.4.1-4.4.4, numbered at the same two-level depth as 4.1 and 4.2 of chapter 4. specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md has '## 4. ENVIRONMENT DIVISION IN THE NUCLEUS MODULE' (line 10455), '### 4.1' and '### 4.2 CONFIGURATION SECTION' (line 10461), but '## 4.4 THE OBJECT-COMPUTER PARAGRAPH' (line 10521) with '### 4.4.1'..'### 4.4.4'. So 4.4 is placed at the chapter's level, and its subclauses at the level of its siblings 4.1/4.2. The heading text is all present; only the depth is wrong. This is a structural outline defect, not lost wording, and the claim describes it accurately. The same pattern was accepted in verify-p240-1.
